book.name: EFESUS
book.title: EFESUS Efesus mbal tuku waŋe Paulusŋge kuyarna

content: Sine Kristus mbolŋge abo kitek tigeŋ
Tane buk wam ŋaigonu ke lika Kuate maskenŋge minmba kumaknu minnaig.
Tane kilke te tuku maŋau ŋaigonu dubika guwa ŋaigonu tuku gabat suŋgo kumnemŋge minnaig. Nu kile Kuate tuku pasa pitaide mbal sinamŋge piroka minit.
Sine ŋakmba buk nane taŋaŋ minmba siŋgine wamdus ta ndo dubika nzali ŋaigonu ke lika mingeŋ. Sine taŋgo ŋakmba ndoŋ Kuate tuku pa tam tuku mingeŋ.
Kuate tuku mape maŋau suŋgokanu. Nu sine tuku suŋgomba kume purmba
sine une maŋau mbolŋge kumaknu mingeŋ le Kristus nu kumna le te-tina ta sine nu ndoŋ kile-tidiŋgina. Nu ake sinaŋ sine make patika muskil kile-tidiŋgina.
Nu Kristus te-duŋga sine nu ndoŋ ulendikeg wam ta mbolŋge nu sine turmba kile-duŋga ka samba mbolŋge nu ndoŋ patikina le mineg.
Ait prowe likamŋgaig ta ŋakmba mbolŋge Kuate nu sine ake sinaŋ make patikate wam suŋgo ta kilimok mayok kuwa ŋga nuŋe raŋgun mayenu Kristus Yesus mbolŋge siŋgina.
Kuate nu tane ake sinaŋ make patika tane muskil kile-tidiŋgate ta taŋgine piro mbolŋge kuga. Kuateŋge piya kugatok tiŋgit.
Taŋgo ŋgarosu payamkubekaig ŋga naŋgine piro mbolŋge nu niŋge ndakate.
Sine Kuate tuku wai kuyar mineg. Nu Kristus Yesus mbolŋge sine wam magenu ke likam tuku nu sine abo kitek siŋgina. Nu o buk sine taŋamba minbe ŋga idusna.
Sine Kristus mbolŋge kuasmbi ndindo mineg
Tane Zu ndare mbolŋge mayok nda kinaig ta tane gilai ndaŋgap. Sine Zu taŋgo Kuate tuku mbal ŋga ŋgaro pikeg tuku mbal ŋgeg. Sine buk tane kasomŋge minmba ŋgaro pike ndakade tuku mbal ŋgigeŋ.

Ait ta mbolŋge tane Kristus gilai minmba sine Israel Kuateŋge madisiŋgina mbal kasomŋge minnaig le Kuate nu wam afu kam tuku Israel saniŋgina ta tane nda isnaig. Tane Kuate gilai minmba muskil te-tiwam tuku wam katese ndanaig. Tane taŋgine piti ambokok ta gilai ndaŋgap.
Tane buk Kuate maskenŋge minnaig ta kile tane Kristus ndoŋ ulendika nu tuku ndare mbolŋge Kuate tugumŋge minig.
Nu sile tuma ulendisikam tuku taŋgo. Sile Zu mbal kasomok mbal ŋgueu minkeŋ wam ta nu te-simba sile ulendisikina.
Nu Moses tuku tukul ŋakmba kile-sika nuŋe ŋgarosumbi Zu mbal kasomok mbal kilmba taŋgo kitek ndindo te-mayokna le sile wamdus mukuk minek.
Nu ail kazrai mbolŋge kumna sulumba ŋgueu maŋau kume sermba sile mbal ar te ndindo te-mayokmba Kuate ndoŋ tumana.
Nu pro sine Kuate tugumŋge mingeŋ mbal tane kasomŋge minnaig mbal nu sile ŋgamukŋge pasa mayenu kuklimba Kuate nu wamdus mukuk sile ndoŋ minam tuku ndin tumsikina.
Sile kuasmbi ar te nu mbolŋge Tukul Guwa ndindo ŋak minmba kile sile Mam Kuate tugum kambim kumuŋ.
Ta tuku kile tane kasomok mbal rawe taŋgo mine ndakade. Kuga. Tane sine ndoŋ Kuate tuku mbal mineg. Sine ŋakmba nu tuku wande tuma mbal mineg.
Aposel kame tuan taŋgo kame nane wande ta tugu pilnaig le tane nane mbolŋge tuturde. Kristus Yesus nu wande ta tuku ndame suŋgo.
Nu mbolŋge wande alonu ŋakmba ulendikade sulumba saŋgri tiŋga Kuate nuŋe minam tuku wande suŋgo mayok kinit.
Tane Kristus ndoŋ ulendikade ta tane mata Kuate tuku wande. Nu wande ta sinamŋge nuŋe Guwa pilit ta nu minit.
